title: Araya Thai Massage & Spa

services.name: Massage
services.desc: At Araya Thai Massage & Spa, every service is custom. When you arrive at our San Antonio, Texas, location, you will have the opportunity to meet with your massage therapist first to discuss what you want to achieve with the massage service. The experienced therapist will also evaluate your situation to make recommendations on the best massage techniques and create a customized treatment for the session. Our skilled therapists offer traditional Thai massage, other forms of body massage, and Thai combination massage therapies. No matter what ailment you want to address, we can provide a full body massage that will meet your needs. Book now online to reserve a time at Araya's San Antonio spa.

services.name: Spa package

Our professional staff is committed to listening to your needs and trained to help you select the services that are right for you. Our amazing personal care will take you to a paradise of vitality, well-being, and beauty - inside and out!
